svg.text: Tempi rail crash chain of neglected safety failures
1. On 28 February 2023 a passenger train and a freight train collided near
Tempi, killing 57 people and exposing long-running rail safety failures.
2. The trial opened in Larissa on 23 March 2026 and was adjourned because
of courtroom and technical problems; 36 people face charges, while more
3. The central conflict is whether the crash was treated as a narrow human-
error case or as the predictable result of delayed safety systems,
4. The case matters because transport safety is a promise made by the
state, operators, regulators, contractors, and political leadership
5. Public trust was damaged by allegations of delayed safety-system
implementation, evidence handling disputes, protests, and family demands
6. Open questions include who knew which safety gaps existed, why EU-funded
systems were delayed, and whether the trial can give a complete picture
7. Reuters, 23 March 2026: Greece opens trial over deadly 2023 train crash;
8. Reuters, 1 March 2026: rallies on anniversary ahead of trial; judicial
Use this as a reading map, not as standalone proof.
